changelog:
⚡ What's New & Fixed in v1.6.7:

• 🚀 Official Release v1.6.7: Seamless in-app OTA updates directly connected to jarvisrehaans/Jarvis.

• 🎙️ Smart Wake Detection: Robust multi-word phrase filtering ('Hey Jarvis', 'Hello Jarvis', 'Hi Jarvis') preventing accidental triggers from singing or background speech.

• ⚡ Zero-Delay Audio Capture: Instant microphone streaming with pre-connection buffering so no speech is lost.

• 🎨 Seamless Theme Switching: Dynamic UI color updates without restarting activity or interrupting live conversations.

• 🗣️ Instant Voice Reconfiguration: Voice model updates apply immediately without needing to restart the service.
